# Vendored chess rules

`chess.js` is the unmodified browser ESM distribution from npm package `chess.js@1.4.0` (`dist/esm/chess.js`). `chess.LICENSE` is its BSD-2-Clause license. Upstream: https://github.com/jhlywa/chess.js.

The application loads this local file directly; it requires neither a runtime CDN nor an npm installation/build on Vercel. Only the ESM runtime and license are distributed here; upstream development source maps are omitted.
